title: Cylinder 1 to 6 Misfire & Ignition/Injection Contribution Fault (P0300, P0301, P0302, P0303, P0304, P0305, P0306)
content: SAE P0300 indicates random misfire. P0301 through P0306 indicate specific cylinder misfire (Cylinders 1-6). Firing order: 1-5-3-6-2-4. Troubleshooting Protocol: 1. Disconnect wiring harness connector at suspect cylinder; measure coil primary resistance (0.8-1.2 Ohm) and injector piezoelectric resistance (180-220 kOhm). 2. Swap ignition coil/injector from suspect cylinder to Cyl 1; re-log telemetry. If fault shifts, replace component. 3. Inspect spark plug gap (0.75 mm). 4. Compression test standard: Minimum 175 PSI across all cylinders with <10% variance. Torque spark plug to 23 Nm; coil bracket to 8 Nm; fuel rail bolts to 13 Nm.

title: Turbocharger / Charge Air System Underboost Condition (P0299)
content: SAE P0299 triggers when actual manifold pressure is >20 kPa lower than target boost despite 95% Wastegate / VGT Duty Cycle command. Troubleshooting Protocol: 1. Pressurize intake charge air piping to 15 PSI using smoke leak detector. Inspect intercooler boots and charge pipes for tears or loose clamps (Torque hose clamps: 5.5 Nm). 2. Inspect VGT actuator linkage for mechanical binding. 3. Measure boost pressure sensor 5V reference voltage.

title: Mass Air Flow (MAF) Sensor Circuit Range & Calibration Drift (P0101)
content: SAE P0101 triggers when MAF sensor output deviates >15% from ideal gas volume flow (m_dot = V_d * RPM * MAP * VE / 2RT). Troubleshooting Protocol: 1. Inspect MAF hot wire element for oil/dust buildup from air filter. Clean element using dedicated MAF sensor cleaner spray (do not touch wire directly). 2. Verify 5V reference and ground continuity. Replace MAF assembly if drift persists.

title: Exhaust Gas Recirculation (EGR) Flow & Valve Position Failure (P0401)
content: SAE P0401 indicates EGR valve body carbon fouling or valve stuck open. Symptoms: Reduced manifold vacuum, elevated intake air temp (IAT), rough idle across all cylinders. Troubleshooting Protocol: 1. Remove EGR valve body; inspect seat for carbon blockage. Clean or replace EGR valve assembly (Torque mounting bolts: 22 Nm). 2. Perform ECU actuator position test.

title: High Pressure Fuel Pump (HPFP) Fuel Rail Pressure Drop (P0087)
content: SAE P0087 triggers when common rail fuel pressure collapses under load (<150 bar idle, <1800 bar under load). Troubleshooting Protocol: 1. Check Low Pressure Fuel Pump (LPFP) in-tank supply pressure (Nominal 5.5 - 6.5 bar). 2. Inspect HPFP quantity control valve wiring. 3. Replace HPFP pump if high pressure collapses under boost.

title: Engine Coolant Over Temperature & Cylinder Head Gasket Breach (P0217)
content: SAE P0217 indicates coolant temperature exceeding 110°C, often accompanied by adjacent cylinder compression drops (Cyl 2-3 or 4-5). Troubleshooting Protocol: 1. Perform chemical block test for combustion gas in cooling system. 2. Pressurize cooling circuit to 20 PSI and inspect cylinders with borescope. 3. Cylinder head bolt torque sequence: 40 Nm + 90 degrees + 90 degrees.

title: System Too Lean - Bank 1 (Cyl 1-3) & Bank 2 (Cyl 4-6) Lean Trim Fault (P0171, P0174)
content: SAE P0171 (Bank 1) and P0174 (Bank 2) indicate Lambda > 1.45 under load. Troubleshooting Protocol: 1. Check for unmetered air leaks downstream of MAF. 2. Check fuel injector spray pattern on affected bank. 3. Replace O2/Lambda sensor if calibration drift is verified.

title: OEM Fastener & Bolt Torque Specifications Master Sheet
content: Official Fastener Torque Specifications: Spark Plugs: 23 Nm (dry thread, gap 0.75 mm). Ignition Coil / Injector Bracket Fasteners: 8 Nm - 13 Nm. Common Rail Fuel Line Unions: 28 Nm. Charge Air Piping Clamps: 5.5 Nm. EGR Valve Mounting Bolts: 22 Nm. Exhaust Manifold Bolts: 35 Nm. Cylinder Head Bolts: Step 1: 40 Nm, Step 2: +90 degrees, Step 3: +90 degrees in spiral pattern from center. Oil Pan Drain Plug: 25 Nm. Intake Manifold Bolts: 18 Nm.

title: Inline-6 (I6) Engine Physics, Firing Order & Kinematic Equations
content: Engine Architecture: 6.7L Diesel Inline-6 (I6). Firing Order: 1-5-3-6-2-4 across 720 degrees 4-stroke cycle (120 degrees interval per cylinder power stroke). Cylinder Power Index (CPI): Calculated from high-frequency crankshaft angular velocity acceleration derivative d(omega)/dt during expansion stroke. Stoichiometric Ratio: 14.5:1 (Diesel operates lean Lambda 1.2 to 2.5). Mass Airflow residual formula: m_dot = V_d * RPM * MAP * VE / (2 * R * T). Bank 1: Cylinders 1, 2, 3. Bank 2: Cylinders 4, 5, 6.

title: Engine Compression & Cylinder Leakdown Diagnostic Procedure
content: Mechanical Dry Compression Test Procedure: 1. Disable fuel injection system and remove all 6 spark plugs / glow plugs. 2. Thread compression gauge into Cyl 1. Crank engine for 5 compression strokes (approx 4 seconds). 3. Nominal Standard: Minimum 175 PSI across all cylinders. Maximum allowable variance between cylinders is <10%. 4. If low (<150 PSI), perform Wet Compression Test by adding 10ml motor oil into combustion chamber. If pressure rises, piston rings are worn. If pressure stays low, valves or head gasket breached.

title: Exhaust Smoke Diagnostic Guide: White, Black, and Blue Smoke Symptoms
content: Exhaust Smoke Diagnosis: 1. WHITE SMOKE: Indicates coolant entering combustion chamber (Head Gasket Breach P0217 or cracked cylinder head / liner). Sweet smell. Perform cooling system pressure test (20 PSI) and chemical block test. 2. BLACK SMOKE: Indicates unburnt diesel fuel / rich mixture due to insufficient air (Turbo Boost Leak P0299, MAF drift P0101, or stuck open EGR valve P0401). 3. BLUE / GRAY SMOKE: Indicates engine oil burning past worn piston rings, valve stem seals, or turbocharger turbine shaft seal.

title: Engine Knocking, Misfire Vibration & Mechanical Noise Diagnostics
content: Engine Noise & Shaking Diagnostics: Severe vibration / engine shaking indicates unbalanced crankshaft torque impulses from a dead cylinder misfire (P0300-P0306). Metallic knocking under load indicates fuel injector over-fueling or rod bearing wear. Perform cylinder contribution / power balance test by disabling injectors one by one.

title: Vehicle Operating Safety & Emergency Shutdown Protocol
content: Emergency Safety Guidance: If white smoke, engine knocking, or severe misfire (P0303 / P0217) occurs, SHUT DOWN ENGINE IMMEDIATELY. Continuing to drive with coolant in cylinders or raw unburnt diesel fuel will cause hydro-lock, catastrophic piston ring land destruction, cylinder wall scoring, or DPF melt-down.
